name: Apologizing To One Another
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of reconciliation among believers, urging us to address offenses promptly and lovingly. Jesus teaches that if we remember a brother has something against us, we must seek to make things right before worship (Matthew 5:23), and He underscores that forgiveness toward others is essential for receiving forgiveness from the Father (Matthew 6:14). The unity of the body is threatened by division, which leads to ruin (Matthew 12:25), so believers are called to forgive those who repent after being gently corrected (Luke 17:3). Love, rather than hatred, covers sins and promotes peace within the community (Proverbs 10:12), and the Lord's Prayer reminds us that forgiving others is integral to our own forgiveness and spiritual protection (Luke 11:4).
